# GroupDocs MCP Installer

Cross-platform PowerShell installer, verifier, and uninstaller for the GroupDocs MCP server family (Annotation, Comparison, Conversion, Markdown, Merger, Metadata, Parser, Redaction, Signature, Total, Viewer, Watermark). Registers the servers into AI clients — Claude Desktop, Claude Code, VS Code / GitHub Copilot, Visual Studio 2022, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Codex CLI — from one config file or a guided wizard, then verifies each server over a real MCP JSON-RPC session.

## Install

- First run (wizard asks platform, products, channel, clients, storage/output/license paths, metered, then verifies): `./install-groupdocs-mcp.ps1 -Interactive`
- Preview without changing anything: `./install-groupdocs-mcp.ps1 -DryRun`
- Apply + warm caches + verify in one command: `./install-groupdocs-mcp.ps1 -Verify`
- Platform: `-Platform net` (.NET, the default and the only one available today; java, python, node are planned and refused until they ship).
- Channels for net: `docker` (self-contained images from ghcr.io/groupdocs-<product>/<product>-net-mcp, recommended) or `nuget` (`dnx GroupDocs.<Product>.Mcp --yes`, needs .NET 10 SDK). Parser and Total are docker-only (packed tool exceeds NuGet.org's 250 MB limit).
- Versions: `latest` by default; a pin such as `-Version 26.9.0` is checked per product against the MCP Registry before anything is written, and a product never published at that version is skipped with the reason.

## Licensing

- License file: `licensePath` (docker mounts it read-only; nuget passes GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH).
- Metered (pay-per-use): `"metered": true` or `-Metered`, with GROUPDOCS_METERED_PUBLIC_KEY and GROUPDOCS_METERED_PRIVATE_KEY set in the environment. The installer never writes the keys: docker forwards them by name, nuget servers inherit them from the client. Metered wins over a license file when both are set.

## Verify

- `./verify-groupdocs-mcp.ps1` — default `auto` level: spawns each server, performs the MCP handshake (initialize -> tools/list), calls get_license_status (reports version and license mode: evaluation / licensed / metered), then calls its info tool (get_document_info, or get_view_info for Viewer) against the first document found in the storage folder. Degrades gracefully when no document or info tool exists. Exit 0 = all pass, 1 = any failure, 2 = nothing verified.
- With metered expected (`-Metered`), a server that did not engage metered licensing fails with the server's own reason (for example, keys rejected).
- Levels: auto (default) | handshake | toolcall (explicit per-product cases from config).

## Remove

- `./uninstall-groupdocs-mcp.ps1` — defaults remove EVERY GroupDocs server from EVERY known client on every available platform; scope with -Products / -Clients / -Platform; deeper cleanup with -RemoveImages, -PurgeNugetCache, -RemoveCompose. Always supports -DryRun.

## Configuration

- `groupdocs-mcp.config.json`: platform, channel, registry (ghcr|dockerhub), clients, version pin, storagePath, outputPath, licensePath (empty = evaluation mode), metered (true|false — never the keys), products, optional verify overrides.
- Shared paths apply to every product: docker mounts storagePath -> /data (license dir -> /license:ro); nuget passes GROUPDOCS_MCP_STORAGE_PATH / GROUPDOCS_MCP_OUTPUT_PATH / GROUPDOCS_LICENSE_PATH env vars.
- `manifest.json` is the catalog, per platform: channels, naming patterns (image, package, MCP Registry name), package runner, and which products each platform ships.

## Key links

- Repository: https://github.com/groupdocs/GroupDocs.Mcp.Installer
- Product MCP servers (per-product repos): https://github.com/groupdocs-<product>/GroupDocs.<Product>.Mcp (e.g. groupdocs-conversion/GroupDocs.Conversion.Mcp)
- MCP Registry entries: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers?search=groupdocs
- License: MIT (the installer); the underlying GroupDocs engines require a license for production use — https://purchase.groupdocs.com/temporary-license/ — or metered keys: https://purchase.groupdocs.com/faqs/licensing/metered/
